settings.role: G5 frozen policy contact mechanism causal DEV
settings.evaluation_role: G5 flat; same fixed parameters/speed/alpha and saved initial state; external torque intervention, not deployable motor change

primary_outcomes: paired steering rate response and delivered impulse
original path and requested speed error; failure and observed duration retained
experiment_protocol.comparison: none vs each intervention within seed/speed/alpha; compare intervention-minus-none between flat and6cm, not raw migration magnitudes
experiment_protocol.window_basis: 1–3s includes previously observed single-ridge encounter around1.4–2s; check complete6cm P0 event bounds before launch
experiment_protocol.pulse_basis: ±0.2Nm for5ms gives±0.001Nms, near observed4cm negative-segment absolute impulse; pulse at1.5s on flat only
experiment_protocol.limit_semantics: independent simulation causal torque clipped1Nm; motor unchanged; report clipping and requested versus submitted impulse
experiment_protocol.initial_condition_semantics: matched deterministic lanes start at same saved state; quantify pre1s divergence before attributing effects; no solver cache copying

source_actor.conversion: exact arrays, no optimization or architecture change
